parameters.name: interface

interface-mode [parameter2].explanation: The command `interface-mode [parameter2]` sets the operational mode of an interface, where `[parameter2]` specifies the mode (e.g., `access`, `trunk`, or `tagged`).

parameters.name: interface-mode
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: The switching mode of the interface, for example, access.

vlan members [parameter2].explanation: The command `vlan members [parameter2]` assigns the specified VLAN (parameter2) to the interface or VLAN unit in Junos OS.

parameters.name: vlan-name

ma [parameter2].explanation: The command `ma [parameter2]` in Junos is incomplete; it likely refers to `monitor interface` or `monitor traffic` commands for real-time interface or traffic monitoring.

parameters.name: ma
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: "Maintain the associated name."

mep-id [parameter3].explanation: The command `mep-id [parameter3]` in Junos configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) identifier for Ethernet OAM (Operations, Administration, and Maintenance) functionality.

parameters.name: mep-id
parameters.explanation: The ID number of the MEP (Maintenance End Point).

interface [parameter4].explanation: The command `interface [parameter4]` in Junos configures or selects a specific network interface, where `[parameter4]` specifies the interface name (e.g., `ge-0/0/1`).

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, for example, ge-1/0/1.

direction [parameter5].explanation: The `direction [parameter5]` command in Junos specifies the traffic flow direction (e.g., `input`, `output`, or `both`) for applying a filter or policy.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.explanation: The direction of the MEP, for example, down.

ccm interval [parameter4].explanation: The command `ccm interval [parameter4]` sets the Continuity Check Message (CCM) interval in milliseconds for Ethernet OAM in Junos devices.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: The CCM transmission interval time, measured in seconds.

ccm transmit [parameter4].explanation: The command `ccm transmit [parameter4]` configures the transmission interval of Continuity Check Messages (CCMs) in Ethernet OAM, with `[parameter4]` specifying the interval in milliseconds.

parameters.name: transmit
parameters.explanation: The status of the CCM transmission function, for example, enable.

remote-mep mep-id [parameter4].explanation: The command `remote-mep mep-id [parameter4]` configures a remote Maintenance End Point (MEP) identifier for Ethernet OAM connectivity fault management.

parameters.name: remote-mep-id
parameters.explanation: The ID number of the remote MEP.

remote-mep ccm-receive [parameter4].explanation: The command `remote-mep ccm-receive [parameter4]` configures the device to receive Continuity Check Messages (CCMs) from a specified remote Maintenance End Point (MEP).

parameters.name: ccm-receive
parameters.explanation: The status of the CCM reception function, for example, enable.

loss-measurement test-id [parameter4].explanation: The command initiates a loss measurement test with a specified `test-id` and configures it using the optional `[parameter4]` for detailed test settings.

parameters.name: test-id
parameters.explanation: Test ID number.

peer-mep-id [parameter5].explanation: The command `peer-mep-id [parameter5]` specifies the Maintenance End Point (MEP) identifier of the remote MEP in a Junos Ethernet OAM configuration.

parameters.name: peer-mep-id
parameters.explanation: The ID number of the peer MEP.
